dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qw4k](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qw4k) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 50.192 depth occurred on Sep 14 2025 12km SE of Dabeiba. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 6.9494 longitude -76.1732. It impacted 78452 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
